release_name: Secret Lair: A Perfectly Normal Superdrop

reviews.drop_name: Secret Lair x Marvel: Dan Hipp
reviews.thesis: Bristly Bill alone anchors the economics, Dan Hipp's distinctive treatment lands well, Training Grounds should remain popular despite many recent printings, and the two playable blue instants add useful depth.

assertions.summary: Bristly Bill is viewed as worth the price of admission and then some.
Dan Hipp's unique art treatment is viewed as especially successful.
Training Grounds is expected to remain popular in this treatment despite substantial recent reprinting.
Training Grounds has had many recent printings, creating reprint-fatigue pressure.
Mystical Dispute and An Offer You Can't Refuse provide useful playable depth beyond the anchor cards.

reviews.drop_name: Secret Lair x Marvel: True Believers in Love
reviews.thesis: Community buzz around the romantic/shipping theme appears stronger than expected; Grave Pact and Savor the Moment provide enough meaningful card value, and the Marvel treatment is seen as more successful than recent Hulk or Spider-Man executions.

assertions.summary: The reviewer reports meaningful buzz from fans of the romantic pairings/theme.
Grave Pact and Savor the Moment are the two cards viewed as carrying the drop.
The reviewer sees this as a strong model for how Marvel Secret Lairs should use the IP.
Most of the economic thesis is concentrated in two cards rather than the full list.
Two meaningful cards are considered sufficient to support the drop economics.

release_level_thesis: Mixed overall release, but several drops are expected to sell out very quickly. Preferred selective buys are Dan Hipp, Lofi Girl, and Featuring: Gene Luen Yang. The reviewer recommends using bundles plus individual copies in each successful checkout to maximize exposure to the strongest drops. A foil Command Tower is the bonus for each $199 spent. Featuring: Gene Luen Yang is the reviewer's single Pot of Gold pick for the Superdrop.

release_assertions.summary: The reviewer expects some of the strongest drops to sell out very quickly.
Bundles plus individual copies are viewed as the best way to maximize exposure to the strongest drops during multiple successful orders.
A foil Command Tower is earned for each $199 spent and should be treated as an order-optimization bonus rather than the core thesis.
Dan Hipp, Lofi Girl, and Featuring: Gene Luen Yang are the reviewer's preferred selective buys.

release_pick.note: This is the reviewer's single favorite drop in the Superdrop, separate from the numeric 1-10 ratings.
